title: Establish milestone signals and cutline decision matrix for API/Console/Runtime release train
creator: Avery Chen
description: Goal: Create a pragmatic set of milestone signals (alpha/beta/rc/ga), a cutline decision matrix, and an operational runbook for the combined API + Console + Runtime release train. This ticket centralizes who decides scope locks, how cut decisions are made across teams, and the specific signal thresholds (test pass rates, latency windows, error budgets, dependency readiness) that gate a milestone. Deliverables: 1) Signal definitions and numeric thresholds for each milestone; 2) Cutline decision matrix (who votes, quorum, escalation path); 3) Pre-launch checklist and release-notes coordination timeline; 4) Runbook for last-mile decisions during freeze windows and rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Documented milestone signals with quantifiable thresholds for alpha/beta/rc/ga. 2) Cutline decision matrix signed off by Eng, SRE, Product, and Design leads. 3) Release notes owner and content calendar created and linked. 4) Runbook for freeze-window decisions and rollback criteria published and tested in one dry-run. 5) All dependent PM/ENG tickets referenced and no open critical dependencies.
tasks: Workshop with Eng + SRE to define signal metrics (test pass %, p95 latency, error budget consumption, infra capacity)
Draft cutline decision matrix (roles, quorum, tie-breaker, escalation contacts)
Create release-notes calendar and assign owners for API, Console, Runtime sections
Draft pre-launch checklist: doc links, PR list, smoke tests, dashboard links, legal/compliance signoffs
Run a dry-run tabletop for freeze-window decisions and record outcomes
Finalize and obtain stakeholder sign-off (PM, Eng, SRE, Design, Sales Ops)
Publish runbook to Confluence and add to the release-train Slack channel
launch_notes_coordination: Owners: Rohan Patel (overall), Laila Gomez (Console notes), Marcus Lee (Runtime notes), Priya Shah (API examples). Deadline: final draft 72 hours before GA. Template: problem/feature/compatibility/migration/known-issues/upgrade-steps. Distribution: internal release package (all-channel email), release notes page, changelog endpoint. Include brief how-to snippets and example curl/SDK calls for API changes.
communication_plan: Weekly sync (Tue 11:00) with leads. Daily 'freeze-window' channel created 7 days before GA. Stakeholder broadcast cadence: EOW updates during planning, daily updates during last 72 hours. External customer comms: product marketing to draft an announcement 5 days before GA; legal to review by D-3. Enable feature flags for staged rollout and coordinate with Customer Success for high-touch customers.
canary_and_cutline_matrix: Canary gating: 1) Canary region traffic at 1% for 6 hours with no P0/P1 errors; 2) Expand to 10% for 24 hours if metrics stable. Cutline matrix (examples): if test pass rate < 98% -> block; if p95 latency increases > 30% over baseline -> escalate and hold GA; if infra capacity < 80% of projected -> delay or enable burst capacity. Voting model: Eng Tech Lead + SRE lead + PM must concur to lift cutline; if disagreement, Head of Product makes final call.
rollback_criteria: Rollback allowed if any of the following persist for >30 minutes after mitigation attempts: sustained P0 errors affecting >1% of requests, data-consistency incidents, security regressions, or unrecoverable infra failures. Rollback owner: SRE on-call executes rollback plan; PM communicates externally. Post-rollback: immediate incident review and decision to reopen GA window after root-cause identified.
qa_signoff_criteria: Acceptance smoke test matrix completed (API contract checks, end-to-end Console flows, inference latency smoke with production-like KV cache). QA signoff requires: 95%+ automated scenario pass in staging, performance guardrails met, and no open P0/P1 bugs. SRE must approve capacity and observability dashboards.
